job: Show where this screen sits and jump to a parent.
purpose: A list of links ending in the current page. Use it when a screen is several levels deep, such as a run inside a monitor. The last item is a span with aria-current="page". Wrap it in nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb".
useWhen: A screen is three or more levels deep and people need to go up to any parent.
The hierarchy is fixed: workspace, project, item.

avoidWhen.when: There is one obvious place to return to.
The path is a flow in a set order.

parts.role: The nav; holds an ol of li items.
